note: Shorter 'In the flow' lists for the programs every skill runs. The full list of callers is in programs.json; the book says it once, in words.

`scaffold-project.cjs`: the first thing each workflow runs, and each skill that writes, before it writes
`epic-author` in brief mode, to create the EPIC's folder
you can run it any time: running it again changes no folder or file that already exists
`accept.cjs`: every skill with a gate, when you say yes
`epic-author` in register mode, when `check-register.cjs` passes, because a pass is the EPIC register's acceptance
`glossary-author` and `glossary-disposition`, last, to save the Glossary gate log
in a change: `insert-answer.cjs` and `copy-wording.cjs`, for each accepted document they change
`status.cjs`: every skill with a gate, at its close, after `accept.cjs`
`things-author` and `data-model-author`, at their start, to find the entries still open that they must ask again
`frd-workflow`, for an accepted FRD that waits on a data model answer now settled
you can run it any time: it changes nothing
`grade-questions.cjs`: every skill that writes the Question log, after `probing-questions-author` and before its check
`status.cjs`, which reads its results and changes nothing
its "For the person" block is shown at each gate, after the check program's
